thread:
maria_cs: Quick sync — drafting the customer follow-up for today's routing fallback incident. Need one-paragraph summary + timeline + credit proposal. Can folks review?

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED • routing fallback applied and traffic normalized. Incident started 2026-03-16T11:02Z and resolved 2026-03-16T11:27Z. Postmortem scheduled.

alex_oncall: Timeline I have (quick):
- 11:02 UTC: Pager triggered, elevated 503s from inference frontend
- 11:06 UTC: Identified routing compile backlog causing delayed route compilation
- 11:10 UTC: Applied routing fallback to verified model variant (reduced 503s but increased latency)
- 11:27 UTC: Gradual restore to normal routing; tail errors cleared by 11:35 UTC
Seems like ~25m of elevated 5xxs, peak between 11:04–11:12.

sam_eng: Short root-cause note: compile queue backlog grew due to a race in the compile coordinator that prevented some compile jobs from completing under load. Autoscaler didn't enqueue an emergency worker because of the backpressure signal. Fix plan: (1) ensure compile jobs have a bounded retry + timeout, (2) add a soft rate limiter to the compile queue, (3) add signal to autoscaler for stuck compile queue. We'll put a hotfix into staging today.

jess_ops: Draft customer-facing blurb suggestion: "We experienced degraded request success for a subset of requests on 2026-03-16 between 11:02–11:27 UTC due to an internal routing compilation backlog. We mitigated impact by routing traffic to a verified variant; full service was restored by 11:35 UTC. We apologize for the disruption. We are offering an operational credit — details below — and will follow up with our post-incident report and preventative actions." Thoughts? :handshake:

maria_cs: I like that. Proposed credit options to offer (dependent on customer tier):
- Hosted customers: 10% credit on impacted service charges for the billing period
- Dedicated customers: one day of capacity credit (or prorated equivalent)
Please confirm legal/finance ok. Also need a short status page update and an email template.

leo_custsuccess: Wording tweak: replace "we experienced" with "you may have seen" for softer tone. Also include an explicit list of affected endpoints: `/v1/generate` and `/v1/chat` (client-reported 503s). Recommend offering the Dedicated one-day credit for customers who saw >1% error increase.

cto: Approve the proposed credits as drafted. For hosted customers keep to 10% tiered to impact (min 5% for low impact). Please include a line promising the timeline for the permanent fix (ETA in the postmortem). :heavy_check_mark: 

alex_oncall: Customer impact summary for email: ~12 customers saw >5% 503 rate during the peak window; ~45 customers saw transient increased latency but no errors. BrightApps (customer A) had sustained 503s for ~5m during peak. We should include per-customer metrics in followup for those affected.

sam_eng: Hotfix status: pushed a staging branch with bounded compile timeouts and a backpressure metric exposed. Running canaries now. ETA for PR -> prod if canary green: 2026-03-19 18:00 UTC. Postmortem doc will include change list + rollout plan.

maria_cs: Draft email I'm about to send (please edit):
"Hi <CustomerName>,

We wanted to let you know about a recent incident on 16 Mar 2026 that may have affected requests to the Redwood API. Between 11:02–11:27 UTC we saw elevated 5xx errors for some requests to /v1/generate and /v1/chat due to an internal routing compilation backlog. We applied a routing fallback to maintain availability and full service was restored by ~11:35 UTC.

We sincerely apologize for the disruption. As a gesture of goodwill we are offering: Hosted customers — a 10% credit on the impacted billing period; Dedicated customers — one day of Dedicated capacity credit (prorated if applicable). If you would like us to apply a credit now, reply to this message and we'll initiate.

We are performing a full post-incident review and will share the root cause and permanent fixes by 2026-03-20. Action items include queue rate limiting, autoscaler signal improvements, and additional compile telemetry.

Please let me know if you'd like a tailored impact report for your account.

Regards,
Maria (Customer Success)"

jess_ops: Edits: add link to status page and a short FAQ line (how to request credit). Maybe add a sentence: "No action is required if you did not experience errors." Also include a line about contacting support for production-impact escalations.

maria_cs: Updated. Plan: send consolidated email at 17:00 PT, post status page follow-up now with an "investigating -> identified -> resolved -> follow-up" update. Sam, please ping here when hotfix canary passes so we can add the ETA to the postmortem.

sam_eng: Will do. Canary green expected within 2h.

maria_cs: Thanks everyone. Action items: (1) jess_ops publish status-page follow-up now, (2) maria_cs send customer emails at 17:00 PT, (3) sam_eng confirm canary and open PR for hotfix, (4) alex_oncall add per-customer impact notes to the postmortem.

leo_custsuccess: :thumbsup: I'll queue the customer-specific impact reports for the 12 customers who were above threshold.

maria_cs: Closing this sync. We'll attach postmortem link to all emails once published.
